about_the_game:
Celebrate the New Year with Doki Doki Hanetsuki VR—Doodle on her face!?

The traditional Japanese New Year's game "Hanetsuki" is reborn as an exhilarating VR sports game! Face off against charming girls in heart-pounding matches where a "doodling punishment" awaits the loser.

■ Game Flow

1. 【Story Part】―― Doodle on her face if she loses!? A thrilling deal over a punishment game

Your journey begins with conversations with a cast of unique girls. Through a twist of fate, you find yourself in a Hanetsuki match with a special "Punishment Game" on the line: The loser gets their face doodled on!

2. 【Hanetsuki Part】―― A Fierce Battle of Strategy and Reflexes!

It’s more than just hitting a shuttlecock! Experience an intense rally with intuitive VR controls.

  • Parry: Deflect her flashy "Special Shots" with perfect timing!

  • Stamina Management: Aim left and right to make her run, wearing down her stamina.

  • Paddle Smash: Use items to build your gauge and shatter her "Hagoita" paddle with a powerful strike!

  • Victory Conditions: Win by scoring 3 points or completely destroying her paddle!

3. 【Doodling Part】―― Traditional Punishment: Doodle on her face!

The Punishment Game starts every time you score! Feel free to doodle all over her face whenever she misses a shot. Achieve total victory to unlock a special, limit-free session where you can doodle to your heart’s content... Enjoy the victor's privilege while watching her reactions up close!

4. 【Ending】―― The Afterglow of Victory and Special Moments

After the match, enjoy a special conversation with the girl—still wearing your doodles. Each girl has a different reaction... Savor every unique response to your heart's content.

■ Why You’ll Love "Doki Doki Hanetsuki VR"

  • 【Tradition × Modern VR】 Experience a Classic Japanese New Year in VR! Japan's beloved New Year's tradition, "Hanetsuki," evolves into an exciting VR experience! Dive into a serious match with a punishment on the line. A perfect fusion of traditional atmosphere and modern excitement awaits you!

  • 【Point-Blank Range】 The Pleasure of "Inking" Her Face—Only for the Winner! Experience the sensation of marking her face with ink at arm's length. Watching her blush while you ink her face with your brush is a joy you can only find here! Satisfy your mischievous side by doodling on her face as much as you want!

  • 【Absolute Excitement】 Pure Sports Fun: Aim, Hit, and Win! The satisfaction of striking the shuttlecock exactly where you intended is what makes this a true sports game. We've perfected the feel of intuitive VR controller play for a high-quality sports experience!

This winter, why not welcome the New Year with a heart-pounding match in "Doki Doki Hanetsuki VR"?

■ Video Streaming & Content Creation

We welcome everyone to stream or upload videos of this game! No prior permission or notification is required.

However, to help viewers identify the game, please be sure to include the game title in your description. (Including the store page link is optional, but it would make the developer extremely happy!)
